back: A weather map showing the weather over a large area at one time, with station models, isobars and fronts.
A line joining places with the same air pressure.

front: Wind feathers on a station model
back: Full feather = 10 knots; half feather = 5 knots; pennant (triangle) = 50 knots; circle around station = calm.
Steep pressure gradient: strong winds. Widely spaced isobars: light winds.
Low: rising air, cloud and rain. High: sinking air, clear dry weather (cold nights and frost in winter).
Clockwise inward spiral around a low; anticlockwise outward spiral around a high.
Cold front: triangles. Warm front: semicircles. Occluded front: both, alternating on the same side.
Dot = rain; comma = drizzle; star = snow; triangle = hail; three lines = fog or mist.
Strengths: free, local, trusted. Weaknesses: no exact dates or amounts, reliability varies, knowledge being lost.
